nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.dixon_regions
=========================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.dixon_regions

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Dixon anatomical region assignment from DICOM slice locations.

   Regions (HEAD, THORAX, LEGS) are ordered by ascending slice coordinate:
   lowest centroid → HEAD, middle → THORAX, highest → LEGS.



Attributes
----------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.dixon_regions.DIXON_REGIONS

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: DIXON_REGIONS
   :type:  tuple[str, Ellipsis]
   :value: ('HEAD', 'THORAX', 'LEGS')


.. py:function:: region_from_scan_id_fallback(scan_id: str | None) -> str | None

   Last-digit fallback when fewer than three slice-location clusters exist.


.. py:function:: slice_centroid_from_datasets(datasets: list[Any]) -> float | None

   Median slice coordinate across *datasets* (one per slice).


.. py:function:: series_centroids_from_dicom_dir(dicom_dir: pathlib.Path | str, series_numbers: set[str] | frozenset[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, float]

   Return median slice centroid per SeriesNumber under *dicom_dir*.


.. py:function:: assign_dixon_regions(centroids: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, str]

   Map series/scan keys to HEAD, THORAX, or LEGS by ascending slice centroid.


.. py:function:: build_series_region_map(dicom_dir: pathlib.Path | str, series_numbers: set[str]) -> dict[str, str]

   Compute series_number → region from DICOM slice locations.


.. py:function:: peek_scan_slice_centroid(scan: Any) -> float | None

   Download an XNAT scan DICOM zip to temp and return median slice centroid.


.. py:function:: classify_dixon_scans_by_slice_location(scan_ids: list[str], scans_by_id: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]

   Assign DIXON_HEAD / DIXON_THORAX / DIXON_LEGS per XNAT scan_id.
